title: Harness Protocol v2 — Registry Documents
description: Schemas for the concrete JSON documents the Registry layer produces and consumes: transparency-log entries and registration request/response bodies. The HTTP discovery API (search queries and result pages) is specified in prose, not validated here. The registry indexes existing v1 profile/fragment/plugin documents and adds no harness.yaml fields. A document is valid if it matches exactly one of the defined shapes.

sha256.description: Lowercase hex-encoded SHA-256 of the indexed document content.

entryId.description: Registry entry identifier: 'owner/repo' or 'owner/repo@ref' (optionally with a '/path' segment for non-root documents).

kind.description: The indexed content type. 'profile' and 'fragment' are harness.yaml kinds; 'plugin' is a plugin.json manifest.

transparencyLogEntry.description: One append-only transparency-log record. Served as a line of NDJSON at /transparency-log.

indexEvent.title: index event
indexEvent.description: Records that a specific document version was added to the index.

seq.description: Monotonic sequence number; gap-free and strictly increasing.

schema-version.description: The Harness Protocol schema version the indexed document declares (e.g., '1').

delistEvent.title: delist event
delistEvent.description: Records that an indexed entry was removed from the search index. The content is not deleted from the log.

reason.description: Grounds for delisting, per the published content policy.

detail.description: Optional human-readable detail about the delisting decision.

ref.description: Git tag or commit SHA to index. Defaults to the repository default branch if omitted. Authors are encouraged to register tags, not branches.

path.description: Path to the document within the repo. Defaults to 'harness.yaml' at the repo root.

url.description: Registry page URL for the indexed entry.
